content:
* The search for missing Indian tourist Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, who fell into an 8-meter-deep sinkhole in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, has been halted due to safety concerns. Despite extensive efforts involving tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground-penetrating radar, no trace of her has been found besides her slippers. Authorities have deemed it too dangerous to send divers into the sinkhole, citing the safety and health of rescue personnel as a priority. Efforts to flush portions of the underground drainage system and remove debris with excavators have been made, but the search has not yielded any results. Two divers attempted to enter the sinkhole but were pulled out due to the dangerous conditions.

***
